observed: The first lifespan probe attempted to connect before PostgreSQL/schema prerequisites were ready and failed with connection refused.
resolution: Completed database bootstrap, then exercised the unchanged API and observed the missing handoff-preview route returning 404. No product request was exercised in the failed startup attempt.

observed: The probe compared a raw multiline human note with its JSON-escaped representation in the existing legacy Markdown and failed its assertion.
resolution: Retained and reused the original incident/resolution. Verified the unchanged decoded snapshot text and JSON-escaped Markdown representation; did not repeat account, executor-authority or legacy-resolution setup.

observed: 838 passed, 2 failed: current preview/export contained read-time workload observation timestamps; an existing cancellation regression still accessed the legacy saved-snapshot shape.
resolution: Stored-only workload identity replaced the volatile observation projection; the cancellation assertion now reads the versioned snapshot without changing cancellation expectations. The full backend suite subsequently passed 841 tests.

observed: A numeric decoded cursor identity produced HTTP 500 in the actual HTTPS API.
resolution: Validate decoded field types before UUID conversion. A regression test passes and the actual HTTPS request now returns 422 invalid_cursor.

observed: A delayed old copy completion could announce success after selecting a different report. Separately, the browser clipboard-read helper left write permission denied; this was not an application copy failure.
resolution: Content-bound local clipboard feedback passes the failing-before regression. With explicit user approval, temporary clipboard permissions in the disposable lab session proved native structured/current copy byte equality; those grants were removed. Edge profile permissions were never changed.

observed: An early concurrent download wait caused TabBusy and a worker restart; a raw request-interception cleanup raced a late continue; an immediate downloads getter missed a later download.
resolution: Actual download capture passes with listener and click inside one tab.run Promise.all. Edge loading/recovery passes with own-tab network latency, removed after the check. Failed probes are not counted as passing runs.
